hook_line: FIRST SOUTH ASIAN AMERICAN ELECTED TO CONGRESS FROM ARIZONA

hook_stat.sub: Amish Shah's share of the vote in Arizona's 1st Congressional District, with an estimated 99% of votes counted

stats.label: Vote share for Republican Jay Feely, the opponent Amish Shah defeated
Indian-American members who will sit in the House from January 3

diaspora_bullets: Amish Shah says rolling back tariffs and reclaiming Congress's tariff authority from the White House will be a top priority
He pledged to confront rising anti-Indian hate and to join the India Caucus
news_summary: Dr Amish Shah, a Democrat, won Arizona's 1st Congressional District with 52.4% of the vote, becoming the first South Asian American to represent Arizona in the US Congress.
payoff: Amish Shah takes office on January 3, when the new Congress convenes.
